title: ChatCompletionMessageList
description: An object representing a list of chat completion messages.

object.description: The type of this object. It is always set to "list".

data.description: An array of chat completion message objects.

id.description: The identifier of the chat message.

anyOf.description:
If a content parts array was provided, this is an array of `text` and `image_url` parts.
Otherwise, null.

first_id.description: The identifier of the first chat message in the data array.

last_id.description: The identifier of the last chat message in the data array.

has_more.description: Indicates whether there are more chat messages available.

x-oaiMeta.name: The chat completion message list object
